vendor: Siemens Energy (integrally geared range); Turbomachinery International (trade-press corroboration, not a vendor)
scope: Published upper limits on the number of impeller stages in one centrifugal compressor unit: integrally geared machines and beam-style single-casing machines
usage_rule: Stage-count envelope only. Bounds the number_of_impeller_stages input; never a calculation constant. API 617 itself sets no numeric stage limit.

sources.document: Siemens Energy product page: Integrally geared centrifugal compressors
sources.figures: Customized line: up to four pinion shafts with up to eight impellers / stages (API 617 or API 672); standardized frames 10-100: up to four impellers

sources.document: Turbomachinery International: Types of centrifugal compressor configurations
sources.figures: Current beam-style designs limit the number of stages in a single casing to 10 or less (lateral rotordynamics); two-section ~9, three-section ~8

derived_bounds_for_c7b.applies_to: one centrifugal compressor unit (integrally geared or beam-style single casing)
derived_bounds_for_c7b.basis: SRC-SE-IGC up to 8 impellers; SRC-TMI-CONFIG beam-style single casing <= 10 stages
